Good morning. I am the Chairperson of this board. Welcome to your mock personality test.

Nakshatra Thange, it is a pleasure to have you here. I have your details: B.Tech from VIT, Philosophy
And you prefer English as your medium, with a preference for the IAS. Are all these details still correct?

Before we begin, please let me know the intensity you would prefer for this session. We have gentle, which is more supportive, standard, which is a realistic board experience, or tough, where I will act as a devil's advocate and cross-question you more pointedly.
I will write to choose gender.
I think you meant you would like to choose gentle. Just to clarify, gentle means a supportive tone with more thinking time and fewer cross-questions. Is that what you would like?
Alright. Let us begin. You are from Pune, a city known as the Oxford of the East. In your opinion, how has this academic environment influenced the socio-economic development of the region?
